[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Landric''' was the [[Gender/Legends|wife]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Landric]] of [[Emmo sector/Legends|Emmo sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While staying on [[Elshandruu Pica]], Lady Landric had gems and settings worth six million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] stolen from her safe at [[Margath's on Elshandruu Pica|''Margath's'']] by the [[Tanda Marelle|Tombat]]. After promising a full [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] investigation into the theft, the Tombat mysteriously returned the items two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later. The theft led to her husband pressuring the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]] to assign a [[Special Enforcement Officer/Legends|Special Enforcement Officer]], [[Zanza Gata]], to head the Tombat investigation.
